SELECT asset_rows.project_id, asset_rows.project_name, asset_rows.brief_id, asset_rows.name, asset_rows.product_name, asset_rows.product_model, asset_rows.updated_at FROM ( SELECT p.id AS project_id, p.project_name, p.update_time AS project_updated_at, b.id AS brief_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(b.product_name, ''), b.brief_name) AS name, COALESCE(NULLIF(b.product_name, ''), b.brief_name) AS product_name, b.product_model, b.update_time AS updated_at FROM ai_project p INNER JOIN ai_brief b ON b.project_id = p.id AND b.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND b.deleted = 0 WHERE p.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND p.owner_id = #{userId} AND p.deleted = 0
UNION
SELECT p.id AS project_id, p.project_name, p.update_time AS project_updated_at, b.id AS brief_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(b.product_name, ''), b.brief_name) AS name, COALESCE(NULLIF(b.product_name, ''), b.brief_name) AS product_name, b.product_model, b.update_time AS updated_at FROM ai_project p INNER JOIN ai_project_brief_ref ref ON ref.project_id = p.id AND ref.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND ref.deleted = 0 INNER JOIN ai_brief b ON b.id = ref.brief_id AND b.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND b.deleted = 0 WHERE p.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND p.owner_id = #{userId} AND p.deleted = 0 ) asset_rows ORDER BY asset_rows.project_updated_at DESC, asset_rows.updated_at DESC

SELECT CASE WHEN b.create_by = #{userId} THEN 'manage' ELSE COALESCE(( SELECT collaborator_permission.permission FROM ai_brief_collaborator collaborator_permission WHERE collaborator_permission.brief_id = b.id AND collaborator_permission.user_id = #{userId} AND collaborator_permission.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND collaborator_permission.status = 1 AND collaborator_permission.deleted = 0 LIMIT 1 ), 'read') END AS access_permission, b.id AS b_id, b.tenant_id AS b_tenant_id, b.project_id AS b_project_id, b.brief_name AS b_brief_name, b.product_name AS b_product_name, b.product_model AS b_product_model, b.price AS b_price, b.slogan AS b_slogan, b.primary_selling_point AS b_primary_selling_point, b.target_audience AS b_target_audience, b.target_scene AS b_target_scene, b.other_requirements AS b_other_requirements, b.brief_content AS b_brief_content, b.rich_content AS b_rich_content, b.version_no AS b_version_no, b.status AS b_status, b.is_shared AS b_is_shared, b.share_enabled AS b_share_enabled, b.share_token AS b_share_token, b.share_permission AS b_share_permission, b.share_time AS b_share_time, b.create_by AS b_create_by, b.create_time AS b_create_time, b.update_by AS b_update_by, b.update_time AS b_update_time, b.deleted AS b_deleted, version.id AS v_id, version.tenant_id AS v_tenant_id, version.brief_id AS v_brief_id, version.version_no AS v_version_no, version.version_label AS v_version_label, version.content_snapshot AS v_content_snapshot, version.score_snapshot AS v_score_snapshot, version.change_note AS v_change_note, version.create_by AS v_create_by, version.create_time AS v_create_time FROM ai_brief b LEFT JOIN ai_brief_version version ON version.brief_id = b.id AND version.tenant_id = #{tenantId} WHERE b.id = #{briefId} AND b.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND b.deleted = 0 AND ( b.create_by = #{userId} OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ai_brief_collaborator collaborator WHERE collaborator.brief_id = b.id AND collaborator.user_id = #{userId} AND collaborator.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND collaborator.status = 1 AND collaborator.deleted = 0 ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ai_project own_project WHERE own_project.id = b.project_id AND own_project.owner_id = #{userId} AND own_project.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND own_project.deleted = 0 ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ai_project_brief_ref ref INNER JOIN ai_project linked_project ON linked_project.id = ref.project_id AND linked_project.owner_id = #{userId} AND linked_project.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND linked_project.deleted = 0 WHERE ref.brief_id = b.id AND ref.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND ref.deleted = 0 ) ) ORDER BY version.version_no DESC, version.create_time DESC
